newsitem.title: POLAND: Europay boosts operations, targets eastern Europe.
newsitem.headline: Europay boosts operations, targets eastern Europe.

text.p: Europay International, a payment services group, said on Thursday European banks issued 138.3 million of its debit and credit cards by July this year, a 17 percent rise since the end of June 1995.
"By the end of June 138.3 million cards carried our logo," Richard Tischler, public relation director of the Belgium-based company, told a news conference in Warsaw.

He said Europay, which provides European banks with personal payment and related service and is known for cards such as Cirrus, Maestro and Eurocard, had a 59 percent market share in Europe with annual transactions worth about 102 billion Ecus.

Europay's director general for central and eastern Europe Alessandro Tedoldi, also present, said the company planned to increase the number of cards issued in the region to six million by the end of next year from the current 1.7 million.
Europay has a 83 percent market share in central and Eastern Europe, he said.
The company would also like to increase the number of cards issued in Poland to 500,000 by the end of 1997 from the current 157,000, said Lech Figarski, director for Europay's Polish unit.
